public_notes.orientation: Print upside down on the genuinely planar top. The STL is already rotated 180° and placed on the bed; all 19 Pegstr and array models use this top-down orientation.
public_notes.upper_pegs: The integral receiving wall meets the flat top at Z = 5.60 mm. The full hook crowns remain below that bed plane. The front body, including all material above the peg row, passes the sampled nominal tilt-in board-clearance screen.
public_notes.supports: The bin rim now lies flat for upside-down printing. Its closed floor becomes a ceiling and needs suitable accessible cavity supports or a validated bridge. Peg supports also need a fresh slicer review.
public_notes.mount: 2 mounting columns; lower hoop row 1, on the 25.4 mm grid. PF02 #9 upper hooks and PF07 #5 lower hoops retain the shared clipped-root correction. Hoops flex within the print layers.
public_notes.qualification: One-solid CAD, closed meshes and native STEP read-back pass. The body-clearance check uses a sampled nominal route; changed-fit installation, slicing, physical fit and loads remain untested.
